name.full: ceciCela: plan it, prove it, fix it

description.short: Plan it, prove it, fix it: ceci, cela, and trouble in Copilot.
description.full: ceciCela in Microsoft 365 Copilot. trouble runs a four-roles Bayesian debug protocol on a stuck bug and refuses a fix until all four roles agree. ceci turns a goal into a job graph with human gates before contact, posting, payment, or a price. cela reviews whether a change is really done. In chat they cannot read files or run commands, and they say so; the measured versions run in coding agents (npx --yes @actvite/cecicela install --all).
